characterization_lineage.interpretation: source-defined h=-2 cm derivative seam is not aligned to the uniform u grid and large wet-end amplification is poorly represented
exact seam alignment alone is insufficient
using S in the wet extension materially reduces error for several materials but remains outside the frozen gate
higher local interpolation order improves bulk error for some cases but cannot rescue the frozen gate; extreme KSATEXM amplification remains a broad failure mode

localized_threshold_cross_tail.evidence: R3 p99 can satisfy the frozen criterion while maximum error remains above tolerance, with O14 worst case directly straddling h=-2 cm
localized_threshold_cross_tail.meaning: some moderate extensions are close to representable but still unqualified under the current compact table

broad_extreme_wet_extension_conditioning.evidence: all three KSATEXM/KSATFIT=80 stress materials retain large R3 p99 as well as large maxima
broad_extreme_wet_extension_conditioning.meaning: this is not a single-cell seam artifact and should not be repaired by an ad hoc threshold patch

hard_conclusions: No tested C2A candidate passed characterization, therefore no 36-material exact-KSATEXM holdout was opened.
Frozen C1R accuracy thresholds were not relaxed after observing C2A results.
Exact SWAP 4.3.1 KSATEXM remains valid requested physics and must use an explicitly qualified alternative solver such as FullRichards whenever RossFast admission fails.
No production policy may silently replace exact KSATEXM with a smoother conductivity closure.
No R4 compact-table redesign is opened by this closeout. A future exact-KSATEXM research route requires a new representation hypothesis and a new predeclared characterization contract.
what_is_not_concluded: KSATEXM is not declared scientifically invalid.
RossFast is not declared fundamentally incapable of exact KSATEXM under every possible representation.
No claim is made for h>-1 cm, saturation crossing, heterogeneous faces, transient columns, groundwater coupling or MultiSWAP production.

next_route.required_first: freeze an evidence-backed RossFast admissibility matrix
parallel_research_allowed_after_matrix: Class B near-saturation physical closures used identically by FullRichards and RossFast
future separately contracted exact-KSATEXM representation research
next_route.preferred_class_B_lineage: Schaap_and_van_Genuchten_2006_MMVG_family, with published formulation kept distinct from any SWAP5-specific parameter mapping or NHI simplification
